description: AEI Pulse Main Overview: 1,212 isolates rolling window, 4 KPI cards, hospital-wide resistance trend chart, 8 significant alerts card (ICU E. coli resistance drop to Ciprofloxacin), specimen distribution, and top organisms.

ICU Anomaly Alert Card: 8 significant alerts, critical alert: Escherichia coli resistance to Ciprofloxacin [high] in ICU changed from 75% to 37.3% susceptible (z = -5.8) with 28-day daily resistance bar series.
Hospital-wide Resistance Trend Chart Card: 4-week daily longitudinal trends across key antibiotic classes with interactive hover states and legend.
Hospital Surveillance KPIs: Total isolates (1,212), Resistant isolates (64.3%), Most common organism (E. coli 42.7%), Highest resistance (S. aureus to Penicillin 81.9%).
Antibiogram Heatmap Matrix: 9 organisms x 7 antibiotics cross-tabulation with EUCAST color banding and isolate counts.
AEI Pulse Early Warning & Transmission Center: False alarm budget meter, Warning Feed, Transmission Map network, and MDRO cards.
Hospital Ward Transmission Map Card: Directed patient transfer network, central ICU node, ED triage gateway, peripheral health centres, and playback scrubber.
Warning Feed: High, moderate, and watch severity alerts with MDRO chips and outbreak evidence hypotheses.
Patient Pathways & Outbreak Spread: Inter-ward patient transition matrix showing transmission vectors into ICU.
Antibiotic Guidance Interface: Interactive AI clinical advisor computing live empiric recommendations from surveillance isolates.
Empiric Bedside Guidance Card: AI recommendation for E. coli, including susceptibility rankings (% S) and isolate counts (n).
Hospital Situation Report (Sitrep): Executive clinical briefing on AMR metrics, ICU status, and containment actions.
